final: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS health_status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) AS avg_gb_per_minute FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sc.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND sc.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS mean_status_ratio FROM status_averages) SELECT health_status, total_scans, avg_gb_per_minute, avg_gb_per_minute - mean_status_ratio AS difference_from_mean FROM status_averages CROSS JOIN overall WHERE mean_status_ratio IS NOT NULL
